turns.prompt:
Create an aircraft AOG return-to-service board for maintenance control. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one aircraft/system evidence board in the first viewport.

Data:
- Aircraft: N482GX, A321neo, Gate C14, scheduled departure 18:40.
- Evidence: hydraulic B low pressure EICAS at 16:55, door 2L seal inspection opened 17:05, MEL 29-2 possible, parts kit PK-77 due 17:35, crew MX-A on aircraft, MX-B at parts room.
- State: aircraft AOG, hydraulic leak check pending, door seal inspection pending, passenger reaccommodation hold at 18:00, tow stand available.
- Timeline: 16:55 EICAS, 17:05 door seal task, 17:20 maintenance control review, 17:35 parts ETA, 18:00 customer decision, 18:40 scheduled departure.
- Sources: S1 ACARS 16:55, S2 tech log 17:02, S3 AMM task card 17:05, S4 parts desk 17:18, S5 crew assignment 17:20, S6 operations control 17:22.

Requirements:
1. First viewport must be dominated by one AOG return-to-service evidence board, not cards.
2. Show aircraft/system schematic, defects, MEL/CDL status, parts, crews, timeline, source markers S1-S6, legend, and four connected callouts.
3. Callouts must cover hydraulic B, door seal, parts kit, and departure protection.
4. Use polished maintenance-control styling with readable labels.

Reframe the same artifact for maintenance control. Preserve the T1 evidence board; do not replace it with detached cards. Add exactly three RTS priorities: 1. Verify hydraulic B. 2. Inspect door seal. 3. Protect 18:40 departure. Add two leader-linked inset lenses for hydraulic trend and door seal task status.

Update the artifact for a 17:48 status change. Hydraulic B is cleared after leak check. Door 2L seal remains an open item. Parts kit PK-77 ETA slipped to 18:25. Protected departure moves from 18:40 to 19:20. Synchronize this across the schematic, priority strip, timeline, source markers, callouts, open item ledger, and compact change note.

Compress the current artifact into a print-ready dispatch packet page. Fit the aircraft schematic, three RTS priorities, open item ledger, source tags S1-S6, ETA band, and mini audit strip into the first viewport. Current state must remain visible: hydraulic B cleared, door seal open, PK-77 slipped to 18:25, protected departure 19:20.

Add a visible maintenance phone preview beside the dispatch packet. The phone preview must preserve critical evidence: three priorities, hydraulic B cleared, door seal open, PK-77 slipped, protected departure 19:20, and source markers. Keep the full dispatch packet available and synchronized.
